description: The mandatory negative test in the form a control-plane adapter admits. Nothing is installed into Codex and no hook exists for an unbound session to start: the sidecar runs only when Overlord starts it, and its entry point runs the scope gate before the feature flag, the codex --version probe, the server spawn or any network call. With no channel credential it returns no-scope having done nothing, and it has no fallback to a broader credential.

mustContain:
const scope = resolveAgentSessionScope({ agent: CODEX_APP_SERVER_ADAPTER_KEY, env });
  if (!scope) return { reason: 'no-scope' };
createChannelClient({ baseUrl, channelId: scope.channelId, token: scope.token })
